verdict.rationale: Runpod documents and runtime-probes confirm a REST API (live, API-key-gated) for provisioning/monitoring/terminating Pods, a CLI (runpodctl, verified running keylessly with pod/serverless/template management), and official MCP servers (one OAuth-gated for actual resource management, one no-auth for docs) enabling agent-driven end-to-end lifecycle without console use. Community evidence corroborates real-world CLI/template usage but also notes a locked-down execution environment and occasional GPU availability issues. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a full agent-driven create→monitor→teardown cycle via MCP specifically (only docs MCP fully probed keylessly; API MCP only auth-checked), and no third-party report confirming reliability of automated teardown at scale.
